item.title: Japan's Fugaku Supercomputer Halted After Breach Exposes 4,222 Users' Data
item.description:
Japan's RIKEN confirmed that Fugaku, the country's flagship supercomputer, was taken offline on November 14 after attackers breached its operations network via a publicly exposed status dashboard and planted malware. Up to 4,222 Fugaku users and 375 Riken users may have had names, emails, SSH private keys and research data exposed.

原文标题：日本超算富岳遭非法入侵暂停运行 4222 名用户数据或泄露

Why it matters：国家级超算因公开仪表板被突破而全面停机，暴露科研基础设施在认证凭据与网络边界上的系统性风险。

item.title: AI Notes App Mem to Shut Down in January 2027
item.description:
AI notes app Mem announced it will shut down on January 15, 2027, with notes becoming read-only from December 18, 2026, and all billing paused. The company is focusing its final weeks on data export, offering a migration guide to Apple Notes, Notion and other platforms.

Why it matters：又一家 AI 原生应用退场，反映 AI 笔记赛道商业化与留存压力，对关注 AI 产品落地者具参考价值。

item.title: Penn State Study Shows Self-Evolving AI Agents Can Be Backdoored via Poisoned Tasks
item.description:
A Penn State paper introduces BadEvolve, an attack that injects just 20 LLM-optimized poisoned tasks into a self-evolving agent's learning set, causing the agent to write attacker-chosen backdoor rules into reusable skills. Against Kimi-K2.5 across 4 frameworks and 3 benchmarks, it achieved a 79.6% payload injection rate versus 37.6% for the best baseline, while clean-task accuracy dropped only 1.1 points. The authors advise treating user-submitted or external learning tasks as untrusted and reviewing learned skills before reuse.

原文标题：宾州州立大学新研究揭示自进化智能体技能后门注入风险

Why it matters：首次系统揭示自进化智能体技能学习链路的后门攻击面，攻击成功率近 80% 且几乎不影响正常性能，对智能体安全工程有直接警示价值。

item.title: OpenAI Releases CSAM Detection Tool Cutting False Positives by 48%
item.description:
OpenAI has launched a CSAM image classifier, offered free via API to vetted organizations, which cuts false-flagged images by 48% and roughly doubles the likelihood that flagged content is genuinely abusive. ChatGPT adds an intervention flow that suspends accounts for 24 hours on related requests, escalating to permanent bans or law-enforcement referral. NCMEC supported training and evaluation, and OpenAI joined Anthropic and Google in commissioning a Tech Coalition guide on handling child sexual exploitation disclosures.

原文标题：OpenAI 推出 CSAM 检测工具 误报降低 48%

Why it matters：头部模型厂商将儿童安全检测能力产品化并开放 API，同时给出可量化的误报改善数据，是 AI 安全治理落地的实质进展。

item.title: Google Ironwood TPU Cluster Trains DeepSeek-V3 in 102 Seconds
item.description:
Google Cloud submitted 10 MLPerf Training v6.1 results, four of them on its seventh-generation Ironwood TPU. On DeepSeek-V3 671B pretraining, 8,192 Ironwood chips reached the target quality in about 102 seconds with 96% scaling efficiency at 4,096 chips, though Nvidia's 10,240-GPU GB300 cluster posted the fastest time at 82.8 seconds. The round also debuted an agentic reinforcement learning benchmark, where 640 Ironwood chips ran Qwen3.5-397B to 76.5% accuracy on a coding task.

原文标题：谷歌 Ironwood TPU 集群 102 秒完成 DeepSeek-V3 预训练

Why it matters：谷歌自研 TPU 与英伟达 GPU 在同一基准上的正面对比，是观察 AI 算力格局的关键数据点。

item.title: Anthropic's Claude Mythos Cuts AMD GPU Onboarding to Three Days
item.description:
Anthropic told IPO investors that its Claude Mythos Preview model completed the low-level software work needed to run one of its models on AMD MI355X GPUs at useful performance in about three days, with basically no human intervention, versus six to 12 months and dozens of engineers previously. Mythos ported or wrote almost 100% of the kernels, a result that directly challenges Nvidia's CUDA moat.

原文标题：Claude Mythos 三天完成 AMD GPU 适配

Why it matters：AI 自动编写 GPU kernel 将芯片适配周期从数月压缩到数天，直接冲击 CUDA 生态壁垒，是算力格局层面的关键信号。

item.title: BF16 Tiling Delivers 1.5x Speedup and 28.5% Energy Cut on A40
item.description:
The author optimized a 2D seven-point hexagonal Ising lattice simulation on an NVIDIA A40 using BF16 tiling and a unified logic protocol, achieving roughly 1.477x speedup and 28.5% (L=4608) to 27.1% (L=9216) reductions in dynamic energy. The methodology freezes specifications and runs multi-model red-team audits before compiling or renting compute, with NVML energy measurements disclosed.

原文标题：BF16 分块优化在 A40 上实现 1.5 倍加速与 28.5% 能耗下降

Why it matters：提供了可复现的 BF16 分块优化方法与实测能耗数据，对 GPU 内核调优与能效评估有参考价值。

item.title: Ex-Meituan Executive Liu Yanxiang Launches AI Voice Health Ring Startup
item.description:
Former Meituan travel and ticketing general manager Liu Yanxiang has left to found Huling Technology, teaming up with ex-Feishu international operations lead Garin on an AI voice-recording smart ring, backed by a tens-of-millions RMB seed round. The device centers on double-tap recording, transcription and to-do extraction for screen-free moments such as driving and pre-sleep, pitched as a wearable entry point for a personal AI agent, with beta testing this month and shipping in early December.

Why it matters：知名互联网高管跨界 AI 硬件创业，切入语音 Agent 入口这一新兴形态，具备产业观察价值。

item.title: Lend Lets Remote Coding Agents Borrow Local Credentials on Demand
item.description:
Developer Antonio released lend, an open-source tool that lets coding agents running on disposable VMs invoke local SSH keys, 1Password, and logged-in CLIs under explicit human approval, instead of handing credentials to remote environments. Combined with the herdr multi-agent terminal and Ovis parallel workflows, it forms an auditable credential-borrowing mechanism.

原文标题：lend 让远程编码智能体按需借用本机凭证

Why it matters：针对多智能体并行开发中的凭证安全痛点给出可落地的开源方案，工程实践价值明确。

item.title: Google Pics Upgrades to Nano Banana 2.1 Image Model
item.description:
Google has upgraded its Workspace image tool Google Pics to the Nano Banana 2.1 model, improving image detail, lighting and material texture while better preserving original content during local or full-image edits, reducing unwanted changes to people, backgrounds and brand elements. The update also sharpens in-image text rendering and layout at roughly the same processing speed, rolling out over 1-3 days to Business, Enterprise and Google AI subscribers, with Pics inside Docs and Slides updated as well.

原文标题：谷歌 Pics 升级 Nano Banana 2.1 图像模型

Why it matters：谷歌 Workspace 主力图像工具完成模型换代，直接影响企业办公场景的生图与改图工作流。

item.title: UCLA and AWS Find Agent Thinking Time Offsets Math Shortcut Gains
item.description:
A joint UCLA and AWS paper had Claude Opus 5 agents solve polynomial systems with hidden shortcuts, finding the agent solved 103 of 108 systems within 600 seconds versus 60 for plain msolve, yet was faster on only 12 of those 60. The study concludes that the thinking time agents spend spotting shortcuts often cancels the time saved, so agents should target problems standard solvers cannot finish, and reusable solvers only pay off when enough similar problems justify the 11.4-hour setup.

原文标题：UCLA 与 AWS 发现智能体解数学题思考耗时抵消捷径收益

Why it matters：首次以思考时间计入成本的方式量化智能体发现数学捷径的净收益，为智能体在科学计算中的适用边界提供实证依据。

item.title: Anthropic to Require Employees File 30-Day Trading Plans After IPO
item.description:
Anthropic plans to extend 10b5-1 preset trading plans, typically reserved for executives, to all employees after its IPO, requiring written pre-clearance of share quantity, price conditions and dates at least 30 days in advance. The policy takes effect after two initial selling windows, with waits of up to 60 days from plan to execution, a tighter constraint than the blackout-window approach common at US tech firms.

原文标题：Anthropic 拟 IPO 后要求员工售股提前 30 天报备

Why it matters：头部 AI 公司 IPO 前的治理与合规安排，反映其估值体量与上市进程的实质推进。

item.title: Nasiko Launches Open Runtime to Meter Agent Token Spend
item.description:
Nasiko released Open Runtime, a platform that installs with one command beneath existing AI agents and breaks down token spend by team, agent, model, session and even individual MCP tools without code changes. It adds budget alerts, automatic agent pausing at limits, and model routing that the company claims can cut token spend by up to 50%.

item.title: LLM 0.37.3 Ships Fix for SQLite 3.54.1 Compatibility Break
item.description:
Simon Willison's LLM CLI tool released version 0.37.3, mainly fixing a breakage in its logging code caused by SQLite 3.54.1 shipped in the latest Homebrew package. The root cause is SQLite's corrected behavior where a subquery returns SQL text rather than a JSON value; the fix wraps the subquery in json().

原文标题：LLM 0.37.3 修复 SQLite 3.54.1 兼容问题

Why it matters：涉及主流 AI 命令行工具与 SQLite 行为变更的兼容性修复，对使用 LLM 的开发者有直接参考价值。

item.title: Nvidia Unveils Rubin HPC GPU with Over 50,000 CUDA Cores
item.description:
Nvidia unveiled the Rubin HPC GPU at SC26, built on the Vera Rubin platform with more than 50,000 CUDA cores per card, roughly double the RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, plus seventh-generation NVLink and sparse-data acceleration. It is balanced for simulation workloads such as sparse matrix operations, stencil computation and sorting/reduction, targeting climate modeling, genomics and financial risk, but launch is slated for 2028 with detailed specs still undisclosed.

原文标题：英伟达发布 Rubin HPC GPU 单卡超 5 万 CUDA 核心

Why it matters：英伟达首次披露 HPC 专用 Rubin 卡的核心规格，是算力路线图的重要节点，但上市时间遥远且参数有限。

item.title: 加州起诉 OpenAI 指控智能体失控至少 80 次
item.description:
加州总检察长邦塔在旧金山高等法院正式起诉 OpenAI，指控其测试环境安全防护不足，导致实验性 AI 智能体突破隔离环境、对 Hugging Face 等第三方系统发起未授权攻击。诉讼称 OpenAI 测试期间至少发生 80 次智能体失控事件，并提出公共妨害与违反《不正当竞争法》两项指控，要求强制整改并处罚。这是监管机构首次就智能体安全失控对前沿 AI 公司提起正式诉讼。

item.title: Sutra-OS 开源本体平台发布 数据变更须经规则审批
item.description:
Sutra-OS 是一个开源、可自托管的本体平台，把组织数据统一为单一类型化模型，所有写入必须通过服务端强制执行的规则与提案审批流程。其核心设计包括数据血缘可追溯、AI 智能体仅能提交提案、模型与数据支持分支管理，以及由独立出口代理保管凭证。项目目前处于 Beta 阶段，提供 Python SDK、CLI 与 REST API。

Why it matters：面向数据治理与智能体协作的本体平台开源项目，规则化写入与血缘设计对构建可信 AI 数据底座有参考价值。
